name: Storytelling
description: Using narrative to make ideas easier to understand, remember, and share.

name: Commander's Intent
description: A concise statement of the desired end state that guides decentralized decision making in uncertain environments.

name: Finding the Core
description: Reducing an idea to its single most important message so that people can understand, remember, and act on it.

name: Core Message Prioritization
description: Identifying and communicating the most important idea first so that people immediately understand what matters most.

name: Inverted Pyramid Structure
description: A communication structure that presents the most important information first and progressively adds supporting details.

name: Strategic Decision Filter
description: A simple guiding principle that allows individuals and teams to evaluate decisions consistently without requiring detailed instructions for every situation.

name: Forced Prioritization
description: The practice of deliberately choosing the single most important message, objective, or idea when multiple valid options compete for attention.

name: Message Triage
description: The process of eliminating secondary messages so that communication remains focused on the highest-priority idea.

name: Decision Paralysis
description: A state where complexity, uncertainty, or competing options make it difficult to choose a course of action.

name: Core Message Transmission
description: The process of translating a strategic priority into a memorable and actionable message that guides decisions throughout an organization.

name: Concrete Decision Heuristic
description: A simple, tangible phrase that helps people make consistent decisions without requiring detailed instructions.

name: Compact Communication
description: Reducing an idea to a concise form that preserves its core meaning while increasing memorability and usability.

name: Core and Compact Messaging
description: The combination of a meaningful core idea and concise expression that makes a message memorable, actionable, and durable.

name: Proverb-Based Communication
description: The use of short, experience-based statements that encode practical wisdom and guide decisions across situations.

name: Curse of Knowledge
description: The tendency of experts to forget what it is like not to know what they know, causing them to resist simplification and communicate with unnecessary complexity.

name: Feature Creep
description: The tendency for products, systems, or ideas to become progressively more complex as additional features are added over time.

name: Visual Proverb
description: A physical object or visual reminder that communicates a core principle and reinforces decision making.

name: Memory Chunking
description: The process of organizing information into meaningful concepts that reduce cognitive load and improve recall.

name: Schema-Based Learning
description: The practice of connecting new information to existing mental models so that it can be understood, remembered, and applied more easily.

name: Memory Flagging
description: Using compact cues that point to large bodies of existing knowledge stored in memory.

name: Layered Complexity
description: Building complex understanding by starting with simple concepts and progressively adding additional layers of knowledge.

name: Useful Simplicity
description: The principle that information should be simplified enough to guide decisions and actions, even if it is not perfectly complete or precise.

name: High-Concept Pitch
description: A compact description that communicates a complex idea by connecting it to familiar concepts or stories.

name: Generative Metaphor
description: A metaphor that not only explains an idea but also generates new insights, decisions, behaviors, and applications.

name: Behavior-Shaping Metaphor
description: A metaphor that provides practical guidance for how people should think, behave, and make decisions within a system.

name: Attention Pattern Interrupt
description: A communication technique that gains attention by breaking an expected pattern or routine.

name: Unexpectedness
description: The deliberate introduction of surprise or novelty to capture and sustain attention.

name: Attention Retention
description: The practice of maintaining audience engagement after initial attention has been captured.
